name: What are the benefits of upgrading to new window trim materials?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of upgrading to new window trim materials?

acceptedAnswer.text: Upgrading to newer window trim materials like cellular PVC or fiber cement offers numerous benefits, especially in the Bay Area's coastal climate. These materials are highly resistant to rot, pests, and moisture, leading to a much longer lifespan and significantly reduced maintenance compared to traditional wood. They also hold paint exceptionally well, maintaining their appearance for years. This upgrade can enhance your home's curb appeal, improve energy efficiency by creating a better seal, and potentially increase its market value over time.
acceptedAnswer.description: Upgrading to modern trim materials like PVC or fiber cement offers rot/moisture resistance, low maintenance, better energy efficiency, and improved curb appeal.
